method: Existing mapped outline remains the metric anchor. Compare the full London facade May2011 and Chapel listing against this registered outline, rather than fitting each shop independently.

inputs.window_to_eaves_reference_ratio: London May2011: roughly 60px window / 350px eaves-ground; perspective varies across frontage, therefore retained eaves estimate±0.5m.

limits: Do not interpret historical street photos as current shop tenancy.
Current shop signs only where recent listing/official image actually inspected. Unconfirmed London units have no invented tenant signage.
Clock proportions relative to slate slope from recent Chapel listing; no measured clock height.
